_comment: Template for the gitignored mcp/tenants-proxmox.local.json used by
mcp/proxmox-mcp-server.py. Hostnames, addresses and environment names are
why the real file is gitignored (docs/client-data-policy.md) — keep this
template free of all three.
Top-level key = environment key, matched against ACTIVE_ENV (or PROXMOX_ENV).
Add an entry for every environment that has a Proxmox node; the launcher
refuses with the configured list if the active environment has none.
host                 Proxmox node hostname or address, reachable from the
workstation (usually in-tunnel). Topology, not a
secret, which is why it lives here and not in the
vault map.
port                 optional, default 8006.
verify_ssl           optional, default false. Proxmox ships a self-signed
certificate; set true only where a trusted cert is
installed.
env_token_identity   env var holding the FULL token identity as the vault
records it: user@realm!tokenname. The launcher splits
it into PROXMOX_USER and PROXMOX_TOKEN_NAME — passing
the combined value straight through produces a
malformed PVEAPIToken header and a 401 that reads as
a wrong credential.
env_token_value      env var holding the token secret.
Map both env vars in mcp/vault-map.local.json so bin/mcp-run.sh resolves
them at launch: identity from the item's `username`, value from `password`.
Use an API TOKEN scoped to what the agent needs, never a root password.
PVEAuditor on / is enough for read-only inspection; grant write roles
deliberately.

client1.description: Example environment — replace with your own.
